title: About Bidyarthi Free Coaching Centre
text: Bidyarthi Free Coaching Centre, a social welfare organization in Simurali, Nadia, West Bengal (est. 1987) that offers free coaching (Classes V-X), a students' library (5,000+ books), cultural programs, a homeopathic dispensary, ambulance/oxygen service, a book fair, and a kindergarten (Bidyarthi Shishu Niketan).
